sentence: I sincerely apologize for the mistake.
en-dict-meaning: 'Sincerely' means in a genuine and honest way, without pretending. Sincerely shows genuine feeling or expression. People notice a true and heartfelt manner. It is an adverb. For example, 'I sincerely hope you feel better soon' means I truly and genuinely hope so. It is also commonly used at the end of formal letters before signing your name.

sentence: I enclose the document in the letter.
en-dict-meaning: 'Enclose' means to include something inside a letter or package, or to surround something with a barrier. Enclose shows including inside or surrounding. People notice something included with a document or a surrounded area. It is a verb. For example, 'Please find the document enclosed with this letter' means included inside the envelope along with the letter.

sentence: Please notify me if the schedule changes.
en-dict-meaning: 'Notify' means to officially inform someone about something. Notify shows official informing. People notice being told something important in a formal way. It is a verb. For example, 'Please notify us if your address changes' means officially inform us of the change so we have the correct information.

sentence: I’m excited about the upcoming concert.
en-dict-meaning: 'Upcoming' means about to happen or arrive soon. Upcoming shows near future event. People notice something that has not happened yet but will soon. It is an adjective. For example, 'She is preparing for the upcoming exam' means the one that will take place soon.

sentence: We changed our plan accordingly.
en-dict-meaning: 'Accordingly' means in a way that is appropriate to the situation, or as a result. Accordingly shows appropriate action or logical consequence. People notice a response that fits the situation. It is an adverb. For example, 'The rules have changed, so please act accordingly' means change your behavior to match the new rules.

sentence: The supervisor approved the report.
en-dict-meaning: 'Supervisor' refers to a person who watches over and directs the work of others. Supervisor shows person in charge of others. People notice someone managing a team or workers. It is a noun. For example, 'She reported the problem to her supervisor' means the person responsible for overseeing her work.

sentence: Each applicant must submit a résumé.
en-dict-meaning: 'Applicant' refers to a person who formally applies for something such as a job or a place at university. Applicant shows person making a formal request. People notice someone seeking something through an official process. It is a noun. For example, 'All applicants must submit their documents by Friday' means everyone formally applying must do so by then.

sentence: You are eligible to vote at 18.
en-dict-meaning: 'Eligible' means meeting the necessary requirements to qualify for something. Eligible shows meeting the conditions required. People notice whether someone is allowed or qualified. It is an adjective. For example, 'You are eligible to apply if you have two years of experience' means you meet the requirements to do so.

sentence: Please send your resume by email.
en-dict-meaning: 'Resume' means to start again after stopping, or a document listing work experience and skills. Resume shows restarting or employment document. People notice continuing after a break or a job application document. It is a verb or noun. For example, 'She resumed work after her vacation' means started again after stopping.

sentence: I received an invoice today.
en-dict-meaning: 'Invoice' refers to an official document listing goods or services provided and the amount owed. Invoice shows official payment request document. People notice a bill showing what must be paid. It is a noun or verb. For example, 'The company sent an invoice for the work completed' means a document requesting payment for the service.

sentence: This phone has a warranty.
sentence-ko-repr: 이 휴대폰은 보증 기간이 남아 있습니다.
en-dict-meaning: 'Warranty' refers to a written guarantee that a product will be repaired or replaced if it has problems within a set time. Warranty shows official product guarantee. People notice a promise of repair or replacement. It is a noun. For example, 'The washing machine comes with a two-year warranty' means if it breaks within two years, it will be fixed or replaced at no extra cost.

sentence: I want a refund for the broken product.
en-dict-meaning: 'Refund' refers to a sum of money returned to a customer when goods or services are unsatisfactory. Refund shows returned money. People notice money given back after a complaint or return. It is a noun or verb. For example, 'She requested a refund because the product was damaged' means she asked for her money back.

sentence: The street vendor sells snacks.
en-dict-meaning: 'Vendor' refers to a person or company that sells goods or services. Vendor shows seller. People notice someone supplying goods. It is a noun. For example, 'The vendor offered a discount on bulk orders' means the seller reduced the price.

sentence: The shipment arrived on time.
en-dict-meaning: 'Shipment' refers to a quantity of goods transported together. Shipment shows transported goods. People notice a batch of items being moved. It is a noun. For example, 'The shipment arrived at the warehouse on Tuesday' means the batch of goods was delivered that day.

sentence: Don’t forget to get your receipt.
en-dict-meaning: 'Receipt' refers to a written document confirming that money has been paid or goods have been received. Receipt shows proof of payment or delivery. People notice a document confirming a transaction. It is a noun. For example, 'Keep your receipt in case you need to return the item' means the document proving you paid for it.

sentence: I made an itinerary for the trip.
en-dict-meaning: 'Itinerary' refers to a detailed plan or schedule of a journey, listing places to visit and times. Itinerary shows travel plan schedule. People notice an organized list of travel activities. It is a noun. For example, 'The travel agent provided a full itinerary for the trip' means a document listing every stop and activity during the journey.

sentence: I have a reservation at the hotel.
en-dict-meaning: 'Reservation' refers to an arrangement to have something kept for your use at a future time, such as a table at a restaurant or a hotel room. Reservation shows advance booking. People notice something set aside for them in advance. It is a noun. For example, 'She made a reservation at the restaurant for seven o'clock' means she arranged in advance to have a table available at that time.

sentence: My luggage is heavy.
en-dict-meaning: 'Luggage' refers to bags and suitcases that a traveler carries. Luggage shows travel bags and cases. People notice the bags someone brings on a trip. It is a noun. For example, 'She checked her luggage at the airport before boarding' means her bags were registered and stored in the aircraft.

sentence: The flight attendant smiled kindly.
en-dict-meaning: 'Attendant' refers to a person who assists or serves others in a specific place. Attendant shows serving person. People notice someone whose job is to help. It is a noun. For example, 'The flight attendant served drinks' means the person whose job is to help passengers on the plane.

sentence: She picked up a travel brochure at the airport.
sentence-ko-repr: 그녀는 공항에서 여행 안내 책자를 집어 들었습니다.
en-dict-meaning: 'Brochure' refers to a small booklet or folded sheet containing information about a product, service, or place. Brochure shows promotional informational booklet. People notice a printed document used to share information or advertise. It is a noun. For example, 'She picked up a brochure about the hotel at the tourist office' means a small printed booklet describing the hotel.

sentence: The store sells new merchandise every week.
sentence-ko-repr: 그 가게는 매주 새로운 상품을 판매합니다.
en-dict-meaning: 'Merchandise' refers to goods that are bought and sold. Merchandise shows tradeable goods. People notice products available for purchase. It is a noun. For example, 'The store had a wide range of merchandise on display' means many different types of goods available to buy.

sentence: My magazine subscription expires next month.
sentence-ko-repr: 내 잡지 구독은 다음 달에 만료된다.
en-dict-meaning: 'Subscription' refers to an arrangement where you pay regularly to receive a service or publication. Subscription shows regular payment for continued access. People notice a regular payment for ongoing access. It is a noun. For example, 'She has a monthly subscription to a streaming service' means she pays each month to continue using it.

sentence: The old theater is closed for renovation.
sentence-ko-repr: 옛 극장은 보수 공사로 문을 닫았습니다.
en-dict-meaning: 'Renovation' refers to the process of repairing and improving a building or room. Renovation shows repair and improvement work. People notice construction activity to make a place better. It is a noun. For example, 'The kitchen is closed for renovation' means it is being repaired and improved and is temporarily unavailable.
